senses.en: a very long time (informal)

ex.en: I haven't seen you for ages!
ex.zh: 我好久没见你了！

ex.en: It took ages to finish the homework.
ex.zh: 做完作业花了很久。

tip: for ages 是口语“很长时间”，用于夸张表达。
scene: Two friends meeting excitedly after a long time apart.

senses.en: a system that cools the air in a room

ex.en: The office has air conditioning, so it's cool in summer.
ex.zh: 办公室有空调，夏天很凉快。

ex.en: Please turn on the air conditioning; it's so hot.
ex.zh: 太热了，请打开空调。

tip: air conditioning 常缩写为 A/C；air-conditioned 是“有空调的”。
scene: A wall air conditioning unit blowing cool air in a hot room.

senses.en: the part of a country's military that uses planes

ex.en: His uncle is a pilot in the air force.
ex.zh: 他叔叔是空军飞行员。

ex.en: The air force held an air show at the airport.
ex.zh: 空军在机场举行了飞行表演。

tip: air force 是空军；navy 海军，army 陆军。
scene: Military jets flying in formation over an airfield.

senses.en: a machine that records phone messages

ex.en: She left a message on my answerphone.
ex.zh: 她在我的答录机上留了言。

ex.en: The answerphone recorded three calls while we were out.
ex.zh: 我们外出时答录机录了三个电话。

tip: answerphone 是英式说法，指电话答录机。
scene: An old answerphone machine on a desk with a blinking light.

senses.en: except for, or in addition to

ex.en: Apart from the weather, the trip was perfect.
ex.zh: 除了天气，这次旅行很完美。

ex.en: Everyone came to the party apart from Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加聚会了。

tip: apart from 既可表“除了…之外（排除）”，也可表“除了…还（补充）”。
scene: A sunny picnic with an empty chair, everyone there apart from one person.

senses.en: if; on condition that

ex.en: You can borrow the book as long as you return it.
ex.zh: 只要你归还，就可以借这本书。

ex.en: We'll play football as long as it doesn't rain.
ex.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就踢足球。

tip: as long as 引导条件从句，表示“只要”。
scene: Children playing football in a park while the sky stays clear.

senses.en: a medicine that stops pain and fever

ex.en: She took an aspirin for her headache.
ex.zh: 她吃了片阿司匹林治头痛。

ex.en: Aspirin can help with a fever.
ex.zh: 阿司匹林有助于退烧。

col: take an aspirin｜吃一片阿司匹林
tip: take an aspirin 吃阿司匹林；服药说 take medicine。
scene: A hand taking a white medicine tablet out of a small packet.

senses.en: in the beginning, before later

ex.en: At first, the maths problem seemed difficult.
ex.zh: 起初这道数学题看起来很难。

ex.en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
ex.zh: 一开始我不喜欢这座城市，现在我很喜欢。

tip: at first 表示“最初”，常与 later/now 形成对比。
scene: A student frowning at a maths problem, then smiling after solving it.

senses.en: finally, after a long time

ex.en: At last, the bus arrived!
ex.zh: 公交车终于来了！

ex.en: We finished the project at last.
ex.zh: 我们终于完成了这个项目。

tip: at last 强调“经过等待终于发生”，比 finally 更有感情色彩。
scene: People at a bus stop cheering as the bus finally arrives.

senses.en: not less than; anyway

ex.en: You should sleep at least eight hours a night.
ex.zh: 你每晚至少应该睡八小时。

ex.en: At least we tried our best.
ex.zh: 至少我们尽力了。

tip: at least 表示“至少”；反义 at most（至多）。
scene: A clock showing eight on a bedside table with a child asleep.

senses.en: immediately, right now

ex.en: Come here at once! It's important.
ex.zh: 马上过来！有重要的事。

ex.en: She answered the phone at once.
ex.zh: 她立刻接了电话。

tip: at once 是“立刻、马上”的意思。
scene: A parent calling a child to come at once from the doorway.

senses.en: now, at this time

ex.en: At present, she is studying in London.
ex.zh: 目前她在伦敦学习。

ex.en: At present, the shop is closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 目前这家店因装修停业。

tip: at present 是书面语“目前”，等于 now/currently。
scene: A London study desk with books, a girl studying at a window.

senses.en: at one moment together; at once

ex.en: The two trains arrived at the station at the same time.
ex.zh: 两列火车同时到达车站。

ex.en: She can study and listen to music at the same time.
ex.zh: 她能同时学习和听音乐。

tip: at the same time 表示“同时发生”。
scene: Two trains pulling into a station at the same moment.

senses.en: sports such as running, jumping and throwing

ex.en: She is good at athletics, especially running.
ex.zh: 她擅长田径，尤其是跑步。

ex.en: The school athletics meeting is next month.
ex.zh: 学校田径运动会下个月举行。

tip: athletics 是田径运动总称；athlete 是运动员。
scene: Runners sprinting on a red track during an athletics meet.

senses.en: to look after children while their parents are out

ex.en: She babysits for the neighbours on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 她每周五晚上帮邻居照看孩子。

ex.en: I babysit my little cousin when my aunt works.
ex.zh: 姑姑上班时我照看小表弟。

tip: babysit 是动词“照看小孩”；照看者叫 babysitter。
scene: A teenager reading a picture book to a small child on a sofa.

senses.en: a person who travels with a backpack, usually cheaply

ex.en: Backpackers often stay in cheap hostels.
ex.zh: 背包客通常住便宜的青年旅舍。

ex.en: He met other backpackers on the train.
ex.zh: 他在火车上遇到了其他背包客。

tip: backpacker 是背包旅行的游客；backpacking 是背包旅行。
scene: A backpacker with a big backpack looking at a map at a train station.

senses.en: travelling with everything you need in a backpack

ex.en: They went backpacking across Europe last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天他们背包游遍了欧洲。

ex.en: Backpacking is a cheap way to see the world.
ex.zh: 背包旅行是看世界的省钱方式。

tip: go backpacking 是“去背包旅行”。
scene: Two friends with backpacks walking on a mountain trail.

senses.en: a person who makes bread and cakes

ex.en: The baker makes fresh bread every morning.
ex.zh: 面包师每天早上做新鲜面包。

ex.en: She bought a cake from the local baker.
ex.zh: 她从当地面包师那里买了一个蛋糕。

tip: baker 是面包师；bakery 是面包店。
scene: A baker in an apron taking fresh bread out of an oven.

senses.en: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money

ex.en: She opened a bank account to save her pocket money.
ex.zh: 她开了个银行账户存零花钱。

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

col: open a bank account｜开银行账户
tip: open a bank account 是“开户”；save money 存钱。
scene: A person signing a form at a bank counter.

senses.en: the business of running a bank

ex.en: He works in banking in the city centre.
ex.zh: 他在市中心从事银行业。

ex.en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills.
ex.zh: 网上银行让支付账单变得简单。

tip: banking 是银行业；online banking 是网上银行。
scene: A person using online banking on a laptop at home.

senses.en: to use something as the starting point

ex.en: The film is based on a true story.
ex.zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

ex.en: You should base your answer on the facts.
ex.zh: 你的回答应该以事实为依据。

tip: be based on 是“基于、以…为依据”，被动形式很常用。
scene: A film poster next to a book, showing the film is based on the book.

senses.en: to have finished

ex.en: The lesson is over at half past three.
ex.zh: 课三点半结束。

ex.en: When the film was over, we went home.
ex.zh: 电影结束后我们回家了。

tip: be over 表示“结束”；The concert is over. 音乐会结束了。
scene: A classroom clock showing the end of a lesson as students pack up.

senses.en: a person who writes a blog

ex.en: She is a food blogger who posts recipes online.
ex.zh: 她是一位在网上分享食谱的美食博主。

ex.en: The blogger wrote about her trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 博主写了她的日本之旅。

tip: blogger 是写博客的人；blog 是博客。
scene: A young woman typing on a laptop at a café table with a camera.

senses.en: a card you need to get on a plane

ex.en: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在登机口出示登机牌。

ex.en: She printed her boarding pass at home.
ex.zh: 她在家里打印了登机牌。

tip: boarding pass 是登机牌；boarding 是登机/上船。
scene: A hand holding a boarding pass at an airport gate.

senses.en: a place where you buy tickets

ex.en: We bought our train tickets at the booking office.
ex.zh: 我们在售票处买了火车票。

ex.en: The booking office opens at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 售票处早上九点开门。

tip: booking office 即售票处，常见于火车站、剧院。
scene: A train station booking office window with tickets being handed over.

senses.en: always telling other people what to do

ex.en: Her older sister is a bit bossy.
ex.zh: 她姐姐有点爱发号施令。

ex.en: Don't be so bossy; let everyone decide.
ex.zh: 别这么专横，让大家自己决定。

tip: bossy 是形容词，形容喜欢指挥别人的人。
scene: A girl pointing and giving orders to friends in a playground.

senses.en: a container for recycling glass bottles

ex.en: We take our old bottles to the bottle bank.
ex.zh: 我们把旧瓶子送到回收箱。

ex.en: The bottle bank is full; we'll come back later.
ex.zh: 回收箱满了，我们晚点再来。

tip: bottle bank 是街边的玻璃瓶回收点。
scene: Colourful glass bottles being dropped into a bottle recycling bin.

senses.en: a sport where two people fight with gloved hands

ex.en: He trains in boxing three times a week.
ex.zh: 他每周训练三次拳击。

ex.en: Boxing needs strength and quick reactions.
ex.zh: 拳击需要力量和快速反应。

tip: boxing 是拳击运动；boxer 是拳击手。
scene: Two boxers in a ring wearing gloves and head guards.

senses.en: completely new

ex.en: He bought a brand new bicycle.
ex.zh: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。

ex.en: The brand new school opens next week.
ex.zh: 这所崭新的学校下周开学。

tip: brand new 强调“崭新”，比 new 语气更强。
scene: A shiny new bicycle with a price tag still on it.

senses.en: to enter a building by force, usually to steal

ex.en: Someone broke in last night and took the TV.
ex.zh: 昨晚有人闯入偷走了电视。

ex.en: The police caught a man trying to break in.
ex.zh: 警察抓住了一个企图闯入的人。

tip: break in 表示“闯入”；break into 后面接地点。
scene: A policeman beside a door with a broken lock at night.

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to break into pieces

ex.en: They broke up after three years together.
ex.zh: 他们在一起三年后分手了。

ex.en: The ice on the lake broke up in spring.
ex.zh: 春天湖面的冰裂开了。

tip: break up 常见义为“分手”；也指“解散、破碎”。
scene: Two people walking away in different directions on a street.

senses.en: to raise a child, or to mention a topic

ex.en: She was brought up by her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她由祖父母抚养长大。

ex.en: He brought up the idea at the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在会上提出了这个想法。

tip: bring up 可指“抚养”或“提出话题”。
scene: Grandparents walking with a small child in a park.

senses.en: wide; including many things

ex.en: They crossed a broad river by boat.
ex.zh: 他们乘船渡过一条宽阔的河。

ex.en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
ex.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

tip: broad 与 wide 都指“宽”；broad 也引申为“广泛的”。
scene: A wide river with a boat crossing under a bridge.

senses.en: on fire; very hot

ex.en: The burning building sent smoke into the sky.
ex.zh: 燃烧的大楼冒出浓烟。

ex.en: She had a burning fever and stayed in bed.
ex.zh: 她发高烧，卧床休息。

tip: burning 是形容词“燃烧的、滚烫的”。
scene: A small fire burning in a garden fire pit with logs.

senses.en: done using hands, not a machine

ex.en: The card was made by hand.
ex.zh: 这张卡片是手工制作的。

ex.en: Please sign the form by hand.
ex.zh: 请用手写签名。

tip: by hand 表示“手工地”；made by hand 手工制作。
scene: Hands folding a paper card with craft materials on a table.

senses.en: not on purpose

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake.
ex.zh: 我不小心拿错了你的伞。

ex.en: She deleted the file by mistake.
ex.zh: 她不小心删除了文件。

tip: by mistake 与 by accident 都表示“意外地”；on purpose 是“故意”。
scene: A person holding two umbrellas, realizing one was taken by mistake.

senses.en: using the name of a person or thing

ex.en: The teacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 老师认识每个学生的名字。

ex.en: Please address the letter to me by name.
ex.zh: 请把信写上我的名字寄给我。

tip: know sb by name 是“知道某人的名字”。
scene: A teacher calling a student's name from a class list.

senses.en: to need, to demand, or to collect someone

ex.en: This difficult task calls for great patience.
ex.zh: 这项艰巨的任务需要极大的耐心。

ex.en: I'll call for you at eight before the party.
ex.zh: 聚会前我八点来接你。

tip: call for 表示“需要/要求”，也可表示“去接某人”。
scene: A clock showing eight while a person waits by the door with a coat.

senses.en: to visit briefly, or to phone in

ex.en: She called in to see us on her way home.
ex.zh: 她回家路上顺便来看我们。

ex.en: Listeners can call in to the radio show.
ex.zh: 听众可以打电话进广播节目。

tip: call in 表示“顺便来访”或“打电话进来”。
scene: A friend popping by the front door with a small gift.

senses.en: to continue doing something

ex.en: Carry on with your work; I'll wait outside.
ex.zh: 继续你的工作，我在外面等。

ex.en: She carried on talking even after the bell rang.
ex.zh: 铃响后她还在继续说。

tip: carry on (with) 是“继续做某事”。
scene: A student continuing to write notes while others pack up.

senses.en: to do or complete a task

ex.en: The team carried out the plan successfully.
ex.zh: 团队成功执行了计划。

ex.en: Scientists carried out a survey of local birds.
ex.zh: 科学家对当地鸟类进行了调查。

col: carry out a survey｜进行调查
tip: carry out 表示“执行计划、进行调查”等。
scene: Scientists with clipboards observing birds in a field.

senses.en: a machine that gives you money from your bank account

ex.en: I got some money from the cash machine.
ex.zh: 我从取款机取了些钱。

ex.en: The cash machine is outside the bank.
ex.zh: 取款机在银行外面。

tip: cash machine 是英式说法；美式常说 ATM。
scene: A person using an ATM machine on a street to get cash.

senses.en: a machine that gives cash (British English)

ex.en: There's a cashpoint around the corner.
ex.zh: 拐角处有一台取款机。

ex.en: I need to find a cashpoint to get money.
ex.zh: 我需要找台取款机取钱。

tip: cashpoint 是英式说法，等于 ATM。
scene: A cashpoint machine on a shop wall with a person using it.

senses.en: a system that heats a whole building

ex.en: The flat has central heating, so it's warm in winter.
ex.zh: 这套公寓有中央供暖，冬天很暖和。

ex.en: They turned on the central heating in November.
ex.zh: 他们十一月开启了中央供暖。

tip: central heating 是整栋建筑的集中供暖系统。
scene: A radiator heating a cosy room with a control panel on the wall.

senses.en: a room where you change clothes, e.g. at a shop or pool

ex.en: Try the dress on in the changing room.
ex.zh: 去更衣室试穿这条裙子。

ex.en: The swimming pool has separate changing rooms.
ex.zh: 游泳池有分开的更衣室。

tip: changing room 是更衣室；商店里试衣服也叫 fitting room。
scene: A small changing room with a mirror and curtains in a shop.

senses.en: to register at an airport or hotel

ex.en: We need to check in two hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

ex.en: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.
ex.zh: 到达后请到前台办理入住。

tip: check in 是动词短语；check-in 是名词“值机/入住手续”。
scene: A family checking in at an airport counter with luggage.

senses.en: to pay and leave a hotel, or to look at something

ex.en: We checked out of the hotel at noon.
ex.zh: 我们中午退了房。

ex.en: Check out this cool new phone!
ex.zh: 看看这部酷炫的新手机！

tip: check out 指“退房结账”，口语也指“看看”。
scene: A person handing back keys at a hotel reception desk.

senses.en: the process of registering at an airport or hotel

ex.en: The check-in opened two hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 登机手续在起飞前两小时开始办理。

ex.en: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport.
ex.zh: 请带护照去值机柜台。

tip: check-in 是名词形式；动词形式是 check in。
scene: An airport check-in desk with a sign and passengers queuing.

senses.en: the place in a shop where you pay

ex.en: The checkout has a long queue today.
ex.zh: 今天收银台排着长队。

ex.en: She put her shopping on the checkout counter.
ex.zh: 她把买的东西放在收银台上。

tip: checkout 是超市/商店的收银结账处。
scene: A supermarket checkout counter with a cashier and groceries.

senses.en: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes

ex.en: My socks are in the chest of drawers.
ex.zh: 我的袜子在五斗柜里。

ex.en: The wooden chest of drawers stands by the bed.
ex.zh: 木抽屉柜放在床边。

tip: chest of drawers 是带多个抽屉的衣柜。
scene: A wooden chest of drawers with open drawers showing folded clothes.

senses.en: to relax completely

ex.en: We chilled out by the pool all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

ex.en: Chill out! Everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 冷静点！一切都会好的。

tip: chill out 是口语“放松、冷静”。
scene: A person relaxing in a pool chair with sunglasses and a drink.

senses.en: the long-term change in the earth's weather

ex.en: Climate change is affecting weather around the world.
ex.zh: 气候变化正在影响全世界的天气。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the causes of climate change.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化的原因。

tip: climate change 是气候变化的科学术语，常与环保话题相关。
scene: A melting iceberg with a polar bear on a small piece of ice.

senses.en: used to encourage or hurry someone

ex.en: Come on, we're going to be late!
ex.zh: 快点，我们要迟到了！

ex.en: Come on, you can do it!
ex.zh: 加油，你能做到的！

tip: come on 是鼓励/催促用语“快、加油”。
scene: A coach clapping and encouraging runners on a track.

senses.en: difficult to understand

ex.en: The instructions were confusing, so I asked for help.
ex.zh: 说明令人困惑，所以我求助了。

ex.en: The map is confusing; we took the wrong road.
ex.zh: 这张地图让人看不懂，我们走错路了。

tip: confusing 形容事物“令人困惑”；confused 形容人“感到困惑”。
scene: A puzzled driver looking at a complicated road map.

senses.en: the skill or practice of cooking

ex.en: She is taking a cookery class on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 她周六在上烹饪课。

ex.en: My grandmother taught me cookery.
ex.zh: 我祖母教我做菜。

tip: cookery 是“烹饪术”；cookery class 是烹饪课。
scene: A cookery class with students wearing aprons around a table.

senses.en: to draw a line through something written

ex.en: Cross out the wrong answers on the list.
ex.zh: 把清单上错误的答案划掉。

ex.en: She crossed out a sentence and rewrote it.
ex.zh: 她划掉了一个句子重写。

tip: cross out 表示“用线划掉”。
scene: A hand crossing out a word with a pen on a paper.

senses.en: a place where two roads cross

ex.en: Turn left at the crossroads.
ex.zh: 在十字路口向左转。

ex.en: There is a shop at the crossroads.
ex.zh: 十字路口有一家商店。

tip: crossroads 单复数同形；at the crossroads 在十字路口。
scene: A crossroads with cars and a signpost in a town.

senses.en: in a way that shows interest to know more

ex.en: The children looked curiously at the strange machine.
ex.zh: 孩子们好奇地看着这台奇怪的机器。

ex.en: She asked curiously about my holiday.
ex.zh: 她好奇地问起我的假期。

tip: curiously 是 curiously 的副词“好奇地”；形容词 curious。
scene: Children curiously peering at a strange box on a table.

senses.en: to cut something into small pieces

ex.en: Cut up the vegetables before cooking.
ex.zh: 烹饪前把蔬菜切碎。

ex.en: She cut up the paper into small squares.
ex.zh: 她把纸剪成小方块。

tip: cut up 是“切碎/剪碎”。
scene: Hands chopping vegetables on a cutting board in a kitchen.

senses.en: broken or harmed

ex.en: The damaged bike cannot be ridden anymore.
ex.zh: 这辆损坏的自行车不能再骑了。

ex.en: She returned the damaged phone to the shop.
ex.zh: 她把损坏的手机退回商店。

tip: damaged 是过去分词作形容词“受损的”。
scene: A bicycle with a bent wheel lying beside a wall.

senses.en: to make a phone call by dialling

ex.en: In the past, computers used dial-up to go online.
ex.zh: 过去电脑用拨号上网。

ex.en: She dialled up her friend's number.
ex.zh: 她拨了朋友的号码。

tip: dial up 原指“拨号上网/打电话”，现在主要说 dial。
scene: An old computer with a dial-up modem making a connection sound.

senses.en: making you feel sad because it is not as good as hoped

ex.en: The film was disappointing; the ending was weak.
ex.zh: 这部电影令人失望，结尾很弱。

ex.en: It was disappointing that it rained on our picnic.
ex.zh: 野餐时下雨真让人失望。

tip: disappointing 形容事物；disappointed 形容人的感受。
scene: A person walking out of a cinema shaking their head.

senses.en: a person who dives under water or jumps into water

ex.en: The diver explored the coral reef.
ex.zh: 潜水员探索了珊瑚礁。

ex.en: The diver jumped into the pool perfectly.
ex.zh: 跳水者完美地跳入泳池。

tip: diver 指潜水员或跳水运动员；diving 是潜水/跳水运动。
scene: A diver in scuba gear swimming near a colourful coral reef.

senses.zh: 唱片骑师；音乐节目主持人
senses.en: a person who plays music on radio or at parties

ex.en: The DJ played our favourite songs at the party.
ex.zh: DJ在聚会上播放了我们最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: She wants to become a radio DJ.
ex.zh: 她想成为电台DJ。

tip: DJ 是 disc jockey 的缩写，指音乐播放/主持人。
scene: A DJ mixing music with headphones at a party.

senses.en: an official card that allows you to drive

ex.en: He passed his driving test and got a licence.
ex.zh: 他通过了驾驶考试，拿到了驾照。

ex.en: She forgot her driving licence at home.
ex.zh: 她把驾照忘在家里了。

tip: driving licence 是英式拼写；美式是 driver's license。
scene: A driving licence card lying on a car seat.
